networkPolicy.desc: Facebook and AppsFlyer are blocked; the application stays open

notes: Written from the binary and from the tunnel. React Native. What it needs: chik.lbr.co.il, www.lbr.co.il and Firebase. Blocked: the Facebook SDK (graph.facebook.com, seen on launch) and AppsFlyer. Its AppsFlyer prefix was not seen on launch, so only the unprefixed hosts are listed; a prefixed one would pass.
